mechanism: Escitalopram can prolong QT interval, and chlorthalidone-induced hypokalemia and hypomagnesemia further increase risk of cardiac arrhythmias; additionally, thiazide diuretics can increase escitalopram levels through volume depletion.
action: Monitor electrolytes (potassium, magnesium) regularly, obtain baseline ECG, and consider potassium supplementation; monitor for QT prolongation and arrhythmia symptoms.
